permits.name: Kootenay Pass (Highway 3) avalanche control
permits.text: Highway 3 over Kootenay Pass closes for avalanche control, sometimes with little notice, and parking and skiing near the highway can be restricted during control work. Check DriveBC before you go.

areas.title: Commercial heli-ski tenure
areas.why: A commercial heli-ski operator holds a provincial tenure here. The public can still travel here, but expect helicopters and guided groups, and give them room. (The public tenure data doesn't name the operator.)
